Earlier (?) take of Francie

I take it these transcriptions were from the Ceol Na DTéad record of Francie And Mickey, which is one disc/tape I haven’t managed to acquire. But I do have the Donegal Fiddle CD issued by RTÉ, which has Francie Dearg playing it in F - with a very different 2nd part, in ways the 2nd part transcribed here played in F instead of D (or C, as it would be played down a whole tone) and with an ultra-virtuostic leap up to e‘’‘ on the E string at the end. Perhaps they played the simpler setting in G/D when in duet, as it would be a bit of a trick to hit that e’‘’ in unision. This tune was supposedly Francie’s composition, too.
